verdict.rationale: An online tax-services portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's tax data, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes any AI-driven analysis, insight, or suggestion feature. Tax simulators, the 'adapt your tax to your situation' prompt and the statistics pages are standard non-AI services or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
